@yovoice.intro.tagline.defaultMessage: Give your words a voice. Compose your ideas into songs.

@yovoice.guide.new.defaultMessage: Start a speech, story narration, music or score project here, or import text, subtitles or a .yovoice project.

@yovoice.guide.text.defaultMessage: Write some text, pick a model and a voice, and generate speech. Every generation is kept as a version so you can compare and choose.

@yovoice.guide.story.defaultMessage: Import subtitles or a whole novel, voice each line with different characters, then edit on the timeline, add background music and export.

@yovoice.guide.music.defaultMessage: Describe a style and write lyrics to generate a song. Switch to the “Score generation” tab to import MIDI or let AI write a score and render it with a sound font.

@yovoice.guide.voices.defaultMessage: Keep reference audio and favorite voice settings here so a voice stays the same across projects.

@yovoice.guide.settings.defaultMessage: Download and manage models, set up AI services, clean up assets, change the interface language and move the data folder. On first use, download a model here.

@yovoice.guide.assistant.defaultMessage: Press ⌘J (Ctrl+J on Windows) or click the assistant button in the title bar and just say what you want, such as “Create a story narration and give each character a voice.” Set up an AI service in Settings first.

@yovoice.assets.hint.defaultMessage: Assets in use and timeline media can’t be deleted here: replace them in the character or project first, and remove timeline media from the project’s timeline.

@yovoice.assets.deleteBody.defaultMessage: The selected files will be permanently deleted, freeing about {size}. This can’t be undone.

@yovoice.assets.empty.defaultMessage: No assets yet. Generated audio, imported reference audio and media will show up here.

@yovoice.assistant.move.defaultMessage: Drag to move, double-click to extend

@yovoice.assistant.emptyHint.defaultMessage: Write lines or lyrics, rework a melody, score or generate. Just say it and I will work on the piece you have open.

@yovoice.assistant.hideLauncherHint.defaultMessage: You can still open it from the top-right corner or ⌘J

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.failed.defaultMessage: That generation didn't work. Want me to find out why?

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.failedPrompt.defaultMessage: The last generation failed. Find out why and tell me how to fix it.

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.done.text.defaultMessage: Your voice-over is ready. Want a different voice or tone?

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.done.story.defaultMessage: This chapter is dubbed. Want me to check which lines need another take?

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.done.music.defaultMessage: Your song is ready. Want to try another style or tweak the lyrics?

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.done.score.defaultMessage: The arrangement is rendered. Want me to add more layers?

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.donePrompt.text.defaultMessage: The voice-over is done. Suggest how to improve the tone, pauses and voice.

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.donePrompt.stor.defaultMessage: The chapter is dubbed. Check for speakers without a voice, overly long lines and words that may be mispronounced.

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.donePrompt.musi.defaultMessage: The song is done. Suggest how the style and lyrics could be better.

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.donePrompt.scor.defaultMessage: The arrangement is rendered. Suggest parts or variations to add.

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.downloadFailed.defaultMessage: The download didn't finish. Want me to find out why?

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.downloadFailedP.defaultMessage: The last download failed. Find out why and tell me how to fix it.

@yovoice.assistant.nudge.modelReadyPromp.defaultMessage: {name} is installed. Generate a short sample with it.

@yovoice.settings.assistantIntro.defaultMessage: Ocho is the built-in assistant in yovoice. It sees the work you are editing and what you have selected, and asks before deleting, downloading or changing settings.

@yovoice.settings.assistantNudgesHint.defaultMessage: When a generation finishes or fails, or a model download ends, Ocho offers a suggestion in the corner.

@yovoice.settings.assistantMemoryHint.defaultMessage: Tell Ocho your habits in chat, such as a favourite voice or style. It remembers them and follows them in later conversations.

@yovoice.settings.assistantMemoryEmptyHi.defaultMessage: For example, tell Ocho "use the warm female voice for narration by default".

@yovoice.assistant.selectionHint.defaultMessage: Your selection is sent to Ocho with the next message

@yovoice.music.switchBackHint.defaultMessage: Keeps the playback position; press B to switch

@yovoice.settings.precisionHint.defaultMessage: Q4/Q8 are smaller and faster; BF16, F16 and ORIG stay closest to the original quality.

@yovoice.settings.featuresHint.defaultMessage: Turning a feature off hides its entries in the sidebar and the New menu. Existing works and downloaded models stay as they are.

@yovoice.settings.featureStoryHint.defaultMessage: Import text or subtitles and voice each line by character.

@yovoice.settings.featureMusicHint.defaultMessage: Songs, instrumentals and scores, plus their model and sound font settings.

@yovoice.settings.featureAssistantHint.defaultMessage: The floating assistant, its title bar entry and suggestions. With music generation also off, AI service settings and AI casting for books are hidden too.

@yovoice.arrangement.intro.defaultMessage: Plan phrase sources, prepare real and AI audio separately, then assemble them on an editable timeline.

@yovoice.arrangement.projectHint.defaultMessage: The plan and score are saved in an arrangement project.

@yovoice.arrangement.selectHint.defaultMessage: Choose an existing arrangement or create one to start planning.

@yovoice.arrangement.sourceHint.defaultMessage: Auto lets AI choose real or generated sound for each phrase.

@yovoice.arrangement.sourceUndecided.defaultMessage: Choose real or AI for every part before approving the plan.

@yovoice.arrangement.bandSaved.defaultMessage: Band preset saved to the source library

@yovoice.arrangement.bandApplied.defaultMessage: Band preferences applied; review and approve the plan again

@yovoice.arrangement.scoreHint.defaultMessage: Review the AI score before applying it. Existing notes are never overwritten automatically.

@yovoice.instruments.intro.defaultMessage: Manage note-mapped sample instruments and sound fonts. AI model downloads remain in Settings.

@yovoice.instruments.sitesHint.defaultMessage: Sign in on the provider's site or plugin; yovoice does not collect credentials. Check each library's license. Import individual notes here, or load complete libraries in their plugin.

@yovoice.instruments.siteDecent.defaultMessage: Free Decent Sampler VST3 and its libraries. The plugin downloads directly; some packs require an email address or login and are loaded inside the plugin.

@yovoice.instruments.siteDecentLicense.defaultMessage: Free plugin · check each library license

@yovoice.instruments.siteLabs.defaultMessage: Spitfire LABS is now available through Splice INSTRUMENT. Free content needs a Splice login; some packs require a subscription.

@yovoice.instruments.siteDSK.defaultMessage: Free VST3 with pipa, pipa tremolo, erhu, guzheng and flute. Keep the plugin file and its instruments folder together.

@yovoice.instruments.siteDSKLicense.defaultMessage: Free VST3 · private and commercial use

@yovoice.instruments.siteOpenGameArtLice.defaultMessage: CC0 / CC BY and others · per item

@yovoice.instruments.siteSFZ.defaultMessage: SFZ instruments and open sample projects. Some work through plugins; check each project's license.
